capabilities.name: Certified-Pilot Bypass Inventory
capabilities.responsibility: Classify recommendation-capable legacy paths and artifacts by disposition and certified-pilot reachability so bypass risk remains explicit without executing, deleting, rerouting, or legitimizing those paths.
capabilities.authority_role: Repository/runtime safety inventory only; it may identify reachable or deferred bypass paths but cannot authorize recommendation output, alter routing, or certify an otherwise ungoverned path.
safety_invariants: ACTIVE_UNGOVERNED recommendation-capable paths cannot be treated as certified.
Explicitly deferred paths must be unreachable from the certified pilot, static-artifact-only, test-only, dead, or obsolete.
Inventory construction is descriptive and does not execute, import, delete, route, or modify listed legacy paths or artifacts.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing generic bypass-inventory safety control. Current default inventory is scoped to the certified Star Comprehensive pilot and preserves explicitly deferred legacy paths rather than silently treating them as safe.
